newsitem.title: USA: HP unveils new line of color printers.
newsitem.headline: HP unveils new line of color printers.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co on Monday unveiled a line of HP DeskJet color printers aimed at the home market.
In a statement, the company said the DeskJet 690 series printers produce photo-quality color images that are as close to traditional photographs as desktop-printer-produced images have come.

The DeskJet 693C printer, which comes with the HP home project kit, is expected to sell for $349. The DeskJet 690C printer, which is identical to the DeskJet 693C but is packaged without the home project kit, is expected to sell for about $329.

The photo color kit, which contains the HP photo cartridge and a storage container that extends the life of the cartridge, is expected to sell for about $49. The photo paper is expected to sell for about $11.95 for 20 sheets of 8-1/2 inch x 11 inch paper.
